iw: the use of information or information technology during a time of crisis or conflict to achieve or promote specific objectives over a specific adversary or adversaries
iwo: a bloody and prolonged operation on the island of Iwo Jima in which American marines landed and defeated Japanese defenders (February and March 1945)
iww: a former international labor union and radical labor movement in the United States; founded in Chicago in 1905 and dedicated to the overthrow of capitalism; its membership declined after World War I
